shadows.name: outer-card
shadows.purpose: Lift the main content card from the page canvas.

shadows.name: dashboard
shadows.purpose: Give the dashboard shell its page-level elevation.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate modal work from the dimmed page.

shadows.name: device-hover
shadows.purpose: Add a restrained response when a device card is hovered.

motion.name: diagnostics-refresh
motion.purpose: Refresh indicator rotation; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action for a form or section.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--page-bg); font: 650 0.9rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, opacity .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action beside a primary action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary); font: 650 0.9rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled server configuration or account input.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; margin: 16px 0; color: var(--label); font: 400 0.9rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: A primary grouping surface for setup or dashboard content.
components.html:
Initial setup

Configure the server and create its administrator.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px var(--shadow); } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 7px; font: 700 1.2rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.88rem/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Tabs
components.description: Switch between the Profiles, Settings, Diagnostics, and Security work areas.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Xray-easy"><button role="tab" aria-selected="true" class="ds-tab-active">Profiles</button><button role="tab" aria-selected="false" class="ds-tab">Settings</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); overflow-x: auto; } .ds-tabs button { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 42px; padding: 13px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.9rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--primary); } .ds-tabs .ds-tab-active { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tabs .ds-tab-active::after { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: -1px; left: 10px; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0; background: var(--primary); content: ''; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact status label with matching semantic text and color.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-muted); color: var(--muted); font: 700 0.73rem/1.3 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: normal; } .ds-status-positive { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, var(--surface)); color: var(--success); } .ds-status-negative { background: var(--error-surface); color: var(--error); } .ds-status-warning { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--warning) 14%, var(--surface)); color: var(--warning-text-strong); }

components.name: Device Card
components.description: A responsive card for one device, its state, traffic, and actions.
components.css: .ds-device-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; padding: 19px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-device-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); box-shadow: 0 8px 22px var(--shadow); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-device-card strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-device-status { color: var(--success); font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-device-card small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 0.72rem ui-monospace, monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a calm, open control surface for one private VPN server. It favors clear labels, direct actions, and cool neutral space over dense enterprise-dashboard styling. The four-point brand mark is a small anchor in the header; the interface itself stays focused on the administrator's work.

Clear Blue marks primary actions, active navigation, and links. Light and dark themes keep the same role hierarchy while shifting the canvas, text, surfaces, and accent values together. Cards and borders group operational details without making every control compete for attention.
keyCharacteristics: Calm and open, with compact, legible operational content.
Clear Blue accents against cool, low-chroma surfaces.
Layered panels with soft shadows and simple status treatments.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep Clear Blue as the interface's only saturated accent; reserve green, red, and amber for their status meanings.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Keep the strongest shadows on the main work surface and dialogs; inner cards use borders and tonal fills.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with text, and preserve a visible offset keyboard focus ring.

dos: Do use Clear Blue for the main action and active navigation state.
Do keep light and dark themes aligned by semantic role.
Do group controls with spacing, subtle borders, and muted surfaces before adding stronger shadows.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and pair status colors with text.
Do let technical values wrap within their card or field.
donts: Don't add a second saturated accent without a product reason.
Don't turn the panel into a dense enterprise dashboard; keep its groups open and easy to scan.
Don't use heavy shadows on every nested card.
Don't communicate enabled, disabled, warning, or error state through color alone.
